depends_on.description: Ids of steps already in this plan that the new step builds on. Omit when it builds on none. At most 10.

reason.description: Optional one-line note on why. Recorded on the links this call writes, or on the work-log note it leaves. Capped at 500 characters.

report_id.description: Id of the report to add as a step of this plan. It must be a live report in this project that is not already a step of a plan. The report itself is unchanged.
